text.p: Shoney's Inc Tuesday said it decided to close 55 underperforming Shoney's Restaurants as quickly as practical.
The company also said it this week implemented a realignment of its operational management structure to focus on its core Shoney's Restaurants, which it terms its ownership group.

"In our ownership group, we have 419 Shoney's Restaurants led by 50 regional owner/operators. The remaining 71 Shoney's Restaurants, which we have termed our focus group, will have 17 field operations directors dedicated to improvement of their operating performance," said C. Stephen Lynn, chairman of the board and chief executive officer.
"These changes eliminated an entire layer of management and positions our best management resources directly at the unit level," Lynn added.
The company earlier reported income from continuing operations for fiscal 1996 of $26.0 million, or $.61 per share, compared with $11.2 million, or $.27 per share, in fiscal 1995.
